name: Mahrai
title: One of David's thirty mighty warriors
summary: Mahrai was a Netophathite who served as one of King David's thirty mighty warriors. He was known for his bravery and military skill, and he led one of the monthly army divisions in David's military organization. He belonged to the clan of the Zerahites and was responsible for the division that served in the tenth month.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's mighty men
keyEvents.description: Mahrai the Netophathite is listed as one of David's thirty mighty warriors, an elite group of soldiers who distinguished themselves in battle.

keyEvents.title: Leader of the tenth month's division
keyEvents.description: Mahrai was appointed leader of the army division that served in the tenth month, with responsibility for 24,000 men.

keyEvents.title: Identified as a Zerahite
keyEvents.description: In Chronicles, Mahrai is identified as belonging to the clan of the Zerahites, a family branch from the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the Chronicles' roster of heroes
keyEvents.description: Mahrai the Netophathite is also mentioned in the parallel list of David's mighty men in 1 Chronicles.
